explanation: a. lower Wwox transcript in glia-annotated nuclei of the KO pool
what_the_existing_artefacts_support (ide: Pool-level count fall: oligodendrocyte-called 193 to 1 UMI, astrocyte-called 156 to 9 (wwox_glia_ambient.tsv; E14, E15); reproduced by p1b (verdict row 8)
what_they_cannot_decide: Magnitude: the 20- to 44-fold rests on 9 and 1 UMI, interval about 11- to 45-fold (astro), at least 7.8-fold (oligo), against 7- to 12-fold in neurons on the same basis (E15); one pool per arm, so a pool effect and a genotype effect are one and the same (E05, E10); transcript is not protein (E07)
what_new_source_adds: Nothing: no new source measures glial Wwox
strongest_alternative: Observation shared by every other row; (b)/(c) say the lower count is not a real cell-level transcript change
status: supported_by_data (as a descriptive pool-level difference of direction; magnitude imprecise)

explanation: b. differences of depth, quality or detectability
what_the_existing_artefacts_support (ide: Median UMI 4770 vs 4342 and mt similar (E13); a uniform factor would act on neurons and glia alike (E11)
what_they_cannot_decide: Class-specific detectability in a very low-count regime (Wwox detected in 28 to 32 percent of control glia, 1 and 9 KO nuclei positive); library-level quality, because libraries are not separable (E10)
strongest_alternative: Wwox is a low-abundance transcript, so fold change in glia is a small-number statistic and depth sensitivity differs by class
status: compatible (as sole cause of a uniform fall: not supported; as contributor to imprecision of the fold: compatible). Not exclusive with a, c, d, e

explanation: c. ambient RNA, doublets or class calling
what_the_existing_artefacts_support (ide: Ambient neuronal RNA: control glia carry more Wwox per 1e4 UMI than excitatory neurons with 7-fold lower neuronal ambient Snap25 (E16); ambient explains at most about a quarter to a third of the control glial signal (E12). Class rules differ between producer and verifier (p1b section 4.2)
what_they_cannot_decide: Class contamination in the KO pool, especially oligodendrocyte-called nuclei (70 KO nuclei; immature or mixed nuclei may be called glia) and any glial-labelled nuclei that are neuron/glia co-calls; astrocyte class has equal nucleus counts (275 vs 281) so composition alone is not the issue there
strongest_alternative: Class-call contamination (not ambient soup) of the KO glial classes by neurons that lost Wwox
status: compatible (ambient as the main cause: not_supported; class or doublet contamination: not excluded). Not exclusive with a, d, e

explanation: d. recombination or manipulation beyond the expected neuronal population
what_the_existing_artefacts_support (ide: Glial Wwox falls by 95 to 100 percent in the pool (p1b section 2); the Synapsin I promoter is expressed at E12.5 (authors; no progenitor claim in the paper) (E06); Rosa26 tdTomato reporter allele exists in all conditional animals (E08)
what_they_cannot_decide: Whether any glial cell recombined: no reporter readout for glia is reported in the text read, WWOX IF covers CC1 cells only in one region (E07), astrocytes not checked; whether the Cre-carrying parent was male (germline) is NOT_STATED
what_new_source_adds: Documented caveat of the SynCre transgene: ectopic testis expression and germline recombination via male carriers (E17, abstract-level; E18 counter: not from female carriers). A germline-recombined allele would give single-allele loss in every cell, i.e. at most partial fall in glia, not a 10- to 45-fold one, unless the second allele also recombined (INFERENZA). The original line report shows neuronal ablation without glial claims in its abstract (E19)
strongest_alternative: Neuron-restricted recombination with the glial fall explained by e or c
status: compatible; not_decidable for glia. Not exclusive with e (non-cell-autonomous changes could follow neuronal loss) and with c

explanation: e. change of state or composition
what_the_existing_artefacts_support (ide: Oligodendrocyte-called nuclei 3- to 5-fold fewer, OPC-called more (p1b section 5); independent CC1 and PDGFRA staining shows CC1-positive cells 2-fold fewer and OPCs more in S-KO corpus callosum (E09); mature myelin genes lower
what_they_cannot_decide: Whether Wwox falls inside glia that are present or only through loss of a Wwox-high subtype; composition cannot explain the astrocyte class (equal counts, 20-fold)
what_new_source_adds: Precedent that neuronal Syn-Cre deletion of another gene can produce non-cell-autonomous reactive astrogliosis (E20, abstract-level, different gene)
status: compatible for the oligodendrocyte lineage (composition shift itself supported_by_data); not_decidable for the Wwox fall. Not exclusive with a, c, d

explanation: f. not decidable from the data and documentation available
what_the_existing_artefacts_support (ide: One matrix per arm, library and animal index absent, n = 1 per arm (E05, E10); raw reads hup on 2026-11-07 (E21); no reporter or sorted-glia genotype in any deposit; GEO and paper disagree on aggregation (E02, E05)
what_they_cannot_decide: Apportioning the fall among a to e
what_new_source_adds: Two abstracts and one blocked full text: no reporter, genotype PCR or glial Wwox measurement was found
strongest_alternative: A better-resourced reading: the paper's Supplementary Fig 1 or reporter images may show glial tdTomato; not viewed
status: not_decidable (for the apportioning; it holds alongside, not instead of, b to e)
